snippet.title: Humblets | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Humblets on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694600/Humblets/

Humblets is a cozy adventure for 1–4 players that focuses on peaceful exploration rather than farming. Journey through a charming procedural world with your tent, craft and decorate your space, befriend magical creatures, and solve gentle challenges using the magic of cards. No pressure, just wholesome adventures and fireside stories.
